# Collage Maker

Collage maker: arrange 2 to 14 photos from your MegaScenes library into one collage in the layout and style you describe, for birthdays, trips, mood boards and social posts.

## What it does
Pick 2 to 14 photos from your MegaScenes library and describe the layout and style. Claude tells you the price and makes one composition.

**How the files are made:** each collage is generated by an image model. Nothing is made until you say yes, and the price in credits comes first.

The model redraws the photos into one image, so details can differ from the originals.

## Install
In Claude Code:
```
/plugin marketplace add megascenes-app/claude-plugins
/plugin install collage-maker@megascenes
```

## Connecting
- Collage Maker talks to the MegaScenes server at `https://megascenes.com/api/claude/collage-maker/mcp` (Streamable HTTP).
- Connecting opens MegaScenes: sign in, create an account, or continue without one and add your email when you pay (OAuth with PKCE). Then you come straight back to the chat.
- Each collage uses credits from your MegaScenes account and is priced before it runs; new accounts can start with a low-cost trial week.
- The collages show in a viewer in the chat where Claude supports interactive apps; in Claude Code you get the links.

## Tools
| Tool | What it does |
|---|---|
| `list_collage_models` | Models for collages with settings and starting prices. Read-only. |
| `estimate_collage_cost` | Exact price of one collage before it runs. Read-only. |
| `create_collage` | Starts one collage in your account. Uses credits; needs sign-in. |
| `get_collage` | Status and file links. Read-only. |
| `list_my_images` | Your uploads and images made here, to pick the ones to start from. Read-only. |
| `get_account` | Your plan and credit balance. Read-only. |

## Example prompts
- "Make a polaroid collage from my last 6 MegaScenes photos"
- "Create a birthday collage with my latest photos"
- "Arrange my recent trip photos into a travel poster"

## Data and privacy
What you give for the collage (the photos you pick from your library and the layout and style you describe) goes to MegaScenes, stays in your MegaScenes account with the finished file, and is passed to the model provider that makes it. The plugin has no hooks or local scripts and sends nothing else.
